en: Fixed OpenTelemetry exports failing when a proxy took over 10 seconds to reach the collector; it now has 25 seconds, also the most that `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` can allow (previously 30)
zh: 修复了代理连接 collector 耗时超过 10 秒时 OpenTelemetry 导出失败的问题；现在超时时间为 25 秒，这也是 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` 允许的最大值（此前为 30）
